children: Someit Sidhu, through JATT Ventures III L.P., disclosed a 22.1% stake in JATT III Acquisition Corp. The filing, dated Sept. 03, 2026, follows the company’s Aug. 27, 2026 IPO and related sponsor purchases. The move backs the SPAC’s plan to find and complete a business combination.

Sidhu and the sponsor bought the shares to support JATT III Acquisition Corp’s business plan. They state that they “do not have any other agreements to acquire additional ordinary shares at this time.”

As chairman and chief executive officer, Sidhu “is actively involved in pursuing a suitable target for the Issuer’s business combination” and would help “effect any such business combination,” which could lead to changes in the board, structure, or charter if a deal is completed.

JATT Ventures III L.P. is a Cayman Islands limited partnership that serves as the sponsor of JATT III Acquisition Corp, and Dr. Someit Sidhu is its key decision maker. Sidhu, a United Kingdom citizen, is the chairman and chief executive officer of JATT III Acquisition Corp. JATT-affiliated sponsors typically form blank-check companies to acquire or merge with growth businesses, with a focus on healthcare and life sciences.
